title: Dining Philosophers
description:
```
P0  thinking   P1  eating (forks 1,2)   P2  hungry   P3    P4
```
hints: The naive version deadlocks when all five pick up their left fork at the same moment: each then waits forever for a right fork someone else holds. Short random sleeps between the two forks make it happen quickly.
requirements: 5 philosopher threads and 5 fork mutexes; each philosopher thinks, picks up two forks, eats, and puts them down, 20 times
First the naive version (left fork, then right) and a comment on why it can deadlock
Then a fix with `std::scoped_lock` on both forks
Count the meals of each philosopher and print them at the end
stretch: A second fix by ordering: everyone picks up the lower-numbered fork first. And a third with a `std::counting_semaphore<4>` letting at most four sit down.
